notes.title: New Shovel Tool In The Beta Branch
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have a new beta build up with the new shovel/terraforming tool. This is a big improvement over the old system and allows for exact terrain manipulation with a draggable cube. Check it out in the Beta Branch of Buildanauts.

Additionally, We are aware of a bug with the trailer tool where the Tool Belt button is unselectable after equipping the trailer tool. You have to press [TAB].

notes.title: Version 1.2.1.0 is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Version [b][u]1.2.1.0[/u][/b] is now live!

This version has a new system in place to provide faster Save/Load times.

Unfortunately, this means that your older save files are no longer compatible. 

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]
If any issues occur once the update is complete try to clear out the [u][b]SaveData[/b][/u] and [u][b]ActiveData[/b][/u] folders located in your [u][b]Buildanauts/GameData[/b][/u] directory.

notes.title: Check out the Beta build
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

First and foremost, I want to thank everyone who is supporting our game. We encourage you to share feedback to help guide our game development.

We recently uploaded a beta build that should improve the saving and loading for  everybody. Hopefully this helps! Our plan is to publish the build as soon as it is approved by our QA team.

In the meantime, feel free to try the new (beta) build from the beta-beta branch:
1. Right-Click on the Buildanauts application.
2. Select Properties and click on the BETAS tab.
3. Choose ‘beta-beta branch’ from the drop-down feature.
4. Close the Properties window.
5. Notice the Buildanauts application will update to the new build.

If you want to revert to the default build, navigate back to the BETAS tab and choose 'NONE-opt out of all beta programs'.

WARNING: The beta build is still a work in progress and could corrupt your existing saved data. This is due to the rapid game development.

We look forward to your feedback.

P.S. 
We are working on a few more things and will keep you in the loop on our development progress. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: Buildanauts Stuck At 50% Loading Fix
notes.notes: If your initial loading screen is stuck, usually around 50%, please disable real- time protection in Windows Defender or your Anti Virus software. This should fix issues with it not loading.

notes.title: Play Buildanauts in Person!
notes.notes:
Hey Buildanauts fans! We’ve got three opportunities for you to play the game in person, starting this weekend?
 
First off, we’ll be at PAX East in Boston, April 22-24. You can check out the game at the Octopus Tree booth, number 10229.
 
From May 6-8, you’ll also be able to play Buildanauts and the other Octopus Tree games at Wizard World Minneapolis at the Minneapolis Convention Center, booth number 1011.
 
Finally, from May 14-15, you can check us out at the MSP ComiCon on the Minnesota State Fair Grounds! Booth number to be determined.
 
At all three shows, you’ll have a chance to play the games, take home some game information and swag, and win some extremely limited collectables! We hope to see you at the shows!
